# AI NETRA — Local API reference

## Building Intelligence — http://127.0.0.1:8000
| Method | Path | Handler |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/health` | `health` |
| `GET` | `/building/query` | `query_building` |

The building query takes `lat` and `lon` in WGS84. Exact matches include evidence fields for height, area, river proximity and waterlogging-point proximity; unmatched clicks can return nearby polygon candidates.

## Government locations — http://127.0.0.1:8001
| Method | Path | Handler |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/waterlogging/locations` | `get_waterlogging_locations` |
| `GET` | `/health` | `health` |

The `GET /waterlogging/locations` endpoint returns GeoJSON point features. FastAPI interactive docs are at `/docs` for each service.

**Contract warning:** Endpoint names are scanned from current Python source, but response fields are described from the implementation history. Inspect running `/openapi.json` to confirm actual schemas.
